subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Which single public metadata field name and cross-channel scope should OpenClaw accept for channel group config entries?
rationale: This changes the public configuration contract, and OpenClaw policy favors one current canonical config shape rather than aliases or per-channel drift.

options.title: Adopt `name` consistently
options.body: Add one optional string `name` field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, generated metadata, docs, and tests while keeping runtime behavior unchanged.

options.title: Use a different canonical field
options.body: Choose `label` or `description` instead, then implement only that one field everywhere to avoid aliases and drift.

options.title: Decline config metadata
options.body: Keep group entries behavior-only and leave readability to external notes, docs, or channel-provided display labels.

recommendation.title: Adopt `name` consistently
recommendation.body: Add one optional string `name` field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, generated metadata, docs, and tests while keeping runtime behavior unchanged.
